data.title: 02 · 红角与白誓约
data.description: 【废墟温室礼堂·黄昏】02穿着带红色缎带的白色婚纱站在破碎玻璃穹顶下，细小的红角从头纱边缘露出；她把捧花举过肩，绿色眼睛带着顽皮挑衅，下一秒又因为被夸漂亮而露出柔软的笑。
data.action: 破碎穹顶下抛起捧花挑衅回眸，被夸漂亮后笑意变软
data.mood: 顽皮与真心同时露出的花嫁
data.promptProse: Beneath the shattered greenhouse dome, Zero Two holds her bouquet over one shoulder in a white wedding dress with red ribbons and horn embroidery. Small red horns emerge beside the short veil as her challenging green-eyed grin turns into a softer smile. The vertical medium-full view includes broken framing and the aisle below. Orange sunset through fractured glass lights her pink hair and dress folds, projecting angular frame shadows onto the floor.
